JOB_STATUS : Status der Kommunikation - OKAY, wenn fehlerfrei
ANZAHL_MIL : Count of ignition cycles during which MIL was on
STAT_RDY_KKV : Catalyst monitoring completed (readiness flag of catalyst is 0)
STAT_RDY_KVS : Fuel system monitoring completed (readiness flag of fuel system is 0)
STAT_RDY_AUS : Misfire monitoring completed (all misfire readiness flags are 0)
STAT_UBW_TES : Evaporative system monitoring completed (all EVAP readiness flags are 0)
